description: This PHP file defines the class Zend_XmlRpc_Generator_DomDocument, which provides a DOM-based implementation of an XML/RPC generator, extending a base generator class. It manages XML elements and text data, allowing creation and serialization of XML documents for XML-RPC communication.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Generator_DomDocument
classes.description: A DOMDocument-based implementation of an XML/RPC generator, providing methods to manipulate XML elements and produce XML output for XML-RPC.

methods.name: _openElement
methods.description: Creates and opens a new XML element, appending it to the current element.

methods.name: _writeTextData
methods.description: Appends text data to the current XML element.

methods.name: _closeElement
methods.description: Closes the current XML element by moving the context to its parent node.

methods.name: saveXml
methods.description: Returns the entire XML document as a string.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Initializes the internal DOMDocument and sets the current element to the DOM root.
